# Beam Design Language

> A comprehensive React component library by Sunbeam Studios for building design system interfaces.

## Overview
- Package: @sunbeam/beam-ui
- Registry: https://src.sunbeam.pt/api/packages/studio/npm/
- Source: https://src.sunbeam.pt/studio/beam-ui
- Docs: https://design.sunbeam.pt

## Install
```bash
npm install @sunbeam/beam-ui --registry=https://src.sunbeam.pt/api/packages/studio/npm/
```

## Stack
React 19, Panda CSS, Ark UI v4, TypeScript

## Components
- **Button** - Primary action element with multiple visual variants.  
  `import { Button } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/button"`
- **Badge** - Status indicator label for tagging content with semantic meaning.  
  `import { Badge } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/badge"`
- **Card** - Content container with icon, title, description, and call-to-action link.  
  `import { Card } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/card"`
- **Icon** - Material Symbols icon wrapper with accessibility support.  
  `import { Icon } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/icon"`
- **Avatar** - User avatar with image support and initial fallback.  
  `import { Avatar } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/avatar"`
- **Callout** - Highlighted information block for tips, warnings, and info notices.  
  `import { Callout } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/callout"`
- **CodeBlock** - Tabbed code display with optional toggle groups for streaming, version, and mode variants.  
  `import { CodeBlock } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/code-block"`
- **Tabs** - Navigation tabs built on Ark UI with default and dark variants.  
  `import { Tabs } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/tabs"`
- **Tooltip** - Hoverable tooltip overlay built on Ark UI.  
  `import { Tooltip } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/tooltip"`
- **Dialog** - Modal dialog with title, content area, and optional action buttons. Built on Ark UI.  
  `import { Dialog } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/dialog"`
- **Select** - Dropdown select input built on Ark UI with search and custom styling.  
  `import { Select } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/select"`
- **Checkbox** - Checkbox input with label, indeterminate state, and Beam styling.  
  `import { Checkbox } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/checkbox"`
- **TextInput** - Text input field with label, error state, and multiple input types.  
  `import { TextInput } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/text-input"`
- **SearchInput** - Search input with icon and keyboard shortcut hint.  
  `import { SearchInput } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/search-input"`
- **Table** - Data table with sortable columns, row selection, and accessible caption.  
  `import { Table } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/table"`
- **List** - Flexible list component with icon support and multiple layout variants.  
  `import { List } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/list"`
- **Pagination** - Page navigation with page size selector and ellipsis collapse.  
  `import { Pagination } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/pagination"`
- **Accordion** - Collapsible content sections built on Ark UI with single or multiple expand modes.  
  `import { Accordion } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/accordion"`
- **Toast** - Temporary notification message with auto-dismiss after 3 seconds.  
  `import { Toast } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/toast"`
- **Switch** - Toggle switch built on Ark UI for boolean settings.  
  `import { Switch } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/switch"`
- **ProgressBar** - Determinate progress indicator built on Ark UI with size and color variants.  
  `import { ProgressBar } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/progress-bar"`
- **EmptyState** - Placeholder for empty content areas with icon, message, and optional action.  
  `import { EmptyState } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/empty-state"`
- **Skeleton** - Loading placeholder with shimmer animation.  
  `import { Skeleton } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/skeleton"`
- **DatePicker** - Calendar date picker built on Ark UI with day/month/year navigation.  
  `import { DatePicker } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/date-picker"`
- **ColorPicker** - Color selection popover with preset palette and hex input.  
  `import { ColorPicker } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/color-picker"`
- **LabelPicker** - Multi-select popover for issue/PR labels with color indicators and search.  
  `import { LabelPicker } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/label-picker"`
- **AssigneePicker** - Multi-select popover for assigning users with avatar display and search.  
  `import { AssigneePicker } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/assignee-picker"`
- **MilestonePicker** - Single-select popover for milestones with progress indicators.  
  `import { MilestonePicker } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/milestone-picker"`
- **BranchSelector** - Branch/tag selector popover with tabs, search, and create-branch support.  
  `import { BranchSelector } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/branch-selector"`
- **SyntaxHighlighter** - Code syntax highlighting powered by Shiki with custom Beam light/dark themes.  
  `import { SyntaxHighlighter } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/syntax-highlighter"`
- **CodeEditor** - Full code editor powered by CodeMirror 6 with Beam syntax themes and language support.  
  `import { CodeEditor } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/code-editor"`
- **MarkdownRenderer** - Renders GitHub Flavored Markdown to styled HTML using unified/remark/rehype pipeline.  
  `import { MarkdownRenderer } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/markdown-renderer"`
- **MarkdownEditor** - Write/preview markdown editor with formatting toolbar.  
  `import { MarkdownEditor } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/markdown-editor"`
- **DiffViewer** - Side-by-side or unified diff viewer for code review.  
  `import { DiffViewer } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/diff-viewer"`
- **CommentThread** - Threaded comment display with markdown rendering, reactions, and timeline events.  
  `import { CommentThread } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/comment-thread"`
- **KanbanBoard** - Drag-and-drop Kanban board built on dnd-kit with columns and cards.  
  `import { KanbanBoard } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/kanban-board"`
- **CommitGraph** - Git commit history visualization with branch lanes and merge paths.  
  `import { CommitGraph } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/commit-graph"`
- **Charts** - Chart components (Line, Bar, Pie, Area) built on Recharts with Beam theming.  
  `import { Charts } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/charts"`
- **DiagramRenderer** - Renders Mermaid diagram definitions to SVG with Beam theming.  
  `import { DiagramRenderer } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/diagram-renderer"`
- **MathRenderer** - Renders LaTeX math expressions using KaTeX.  
  `import { MathRenderer } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/math-renderer"`
- **ActivityHeatmap** - GitHub-style contribution activity heatmap for the past year.  
  `import { ActivityHeatmap } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/activity-heatmap"`
- **NotificationCenter** - Popover notification list with type icons and mark-read functionality.  
  `import { NotificationCenter } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/notification-center"`
- **FileList** - File browser with list/grid layouts, selection, and metadata display.  
  `import { FileList } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/file-list"`
- **FileUpload** - Drag-and-drop file upload zone with accept filter and keyboard support.  
  `import { FileUpload } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/components/ui/file-upload"`
- **Form** - Type-safe form wrapper integrating Zod schema validation with React Hook Form.  
  `import { Form } from "@sunbeam/beam-ui/form"`

## Foundations
- **Colors**: Warm sunbeam palette with semantic tokens for light/dark mode (sunbeam.orange #fa520f, sunshine scale, ivory/cream surfaces)
- **Typography**: Ysabeau Infant (body/heading), Monaspace Argon (mono)
- **Spacing**: 4px base unit scale
- **Elevation**: Golden shadow system
- **Accessibility**: Section 508 + WCAG 2.1 AA compliant

## Full Documentation
For complete props, usage examples, and API details: [/llms-full.txt](https://design.sunbeam.pt/llms-full.txt)

## Per-Component Docs
Each component has a dedicated markdown file at: `/docs/{component-slug}.md`

## Rendered Pages
To view the fully rendered HTML page with live DOM structure, append `?render=html` to any page URL:
`https://design.sunbeam.pt/components/button?render=html`
